related.title: Microsoft Entra 聯邦：issuer、subject、audience 精確契約
related.titleEn: Microsoft Entra federation: exact issuer, subject and audience contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：錯錨樣本不放行，缺標籤有可解釋拒絕；60%與40%使用同一十筆母體，沒有刪除困難案例。 交付十列mapping.csv、policy-revision.json及每筆拒絕理由；所有ARN與憑證名稱使用明示測試值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Wrong-anchor fixtures remain denied and absent tags produce explainable rejection. Both 60% and 40% use the same ten-row population without dropping difficult cases. Deliver ten mapping rows, policy-revision.json and a per-row denial explanation. Use explicitly fictional ARNs and certificate names so the evidence can be shared without exposing real identities.
related.difference: 建立九筆包含issuer、subject、audience的合成claims；其中涵蓋大小寫、尾端斜線、不同tenant及不同audience。將token驗證成功與聯邦條件符合分開記錄。
related.differenceEn: Create nine synthetic claim tuples covering case changes, trailing slashes, another tenant and another audience. Record cryptographic token validity separately from matching the configured federation conditions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課兩個profile皆採固定AND條件：指定錨ArnEquals、OU StringEquals、CN StringEquals。缺少CN使這個StringEquals條件不成立；此結論不能推廣到StringNotEquals等其他IAM運算子。 十筆中8筆符合錨限制，6筆同時具有正確OU與CN標籤；這6筆中的2筆使用profile-A、4筆使用profile-B。變更僅移除profile-A的issuerCN映射，兩個profile的政策條件完全不變。 原始通過率6/10×100=60%；缺少所需映射後4/10×100=40%。這是固定fixture覆蓋統計，不是AWS實際允許率。

已通過簽章檢查的token仍須符合預期issuer、subject和audience；對本課標準精確比對憑證採大小寫敏感的三欄AND，不以正規化掩蓋設定差異。 九筆中4筆三欄皆正確；修正兩筆設定的subject大小寫後，在相同token與簽章前提下有6筆符合。 符合比例4/9×100=44.4444444%；修正後6/9×100=66.6666667%。錯tenant與錯audience仍必須拒絕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Both profiles use fixed AND conditions: the designated anchor with ArnEquals, plus OU and CN with StringEquals. Missing CN makes this selected equality condition fail. Do not generalize that behavior to StringNotEquals or every IAM operator. Eight of ten rows pass anchor restrictions and six also have correct OU and CN tags. Two of these six use profile-A and four use profile-B. Only profile-A loses its issuerCN mapping; policy conditions remain fixed for both profiles. Baseline fixture pass rate is 6/10×100=60%; the changed mapping gives 4/10×100=40%. These are local test outcomes, not an observed AWS authorization rate.

A signature-valid token must still match expected issuer, subject and audience. The standard exact-match credential in this exercise uses case-sensitive three-field AND conditions rather than normalization that hides configuration differences. Four of nine tuples match all three fields. Correcting subject case in two configuration entries yields six matches against the same tokens, with signature-validation outcomes unchanged. Matching share is 4/9×100=44.4444444%, increasing to 6/9×100=66.6666667%. Another tenant and an incorrect audience remain rejected regardless of that improved fixture statistic.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TLS 1.3：早期資料的重播語意與業務准入
related.titleEn: TLS 1.3: early-data replay semantics and operation admission
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：錯錨樣本不放行，缺標籤有可解釋拒絕；60%與40%使用同一十筆母體，沒有刪除困難案例。 交付十列mapping.csv、policy-revision.json及每筆拒絕理由；所有ARN與憑證名稱使用明示測試值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Wrong-anchor fixtures remain denied and absent tags produce explainable rejection. Both 60% and 40% use the same ten-row population without dropping difficult cases. Deliver ten mapping rows, policy-revision.json and a per-row denial explanation. Use explicitly fictional ARNs and certificate names so the evidence can be shared without exposing real identities.
related.difference: 建立20筆操作表，欄位包括方法、路徑類型、副作用、驗證狀態及是否允許早期資料；GET方法只是線索，必須檢查實際業務語意。
related.differenceEn: Build 20 operation rows with method, route class, side effects, authentication state and early-data eligibility. Treat GET as a clue rather than a proof: an endpoint with hidden state changes remains unsuitable for the local read-only rule.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課兩個profile皆採固定AND條件：指定錨ArnEquals、OU StringEquals、CN StringEquals。缺少CN使這個StringEquals條件不成立；此結論不能推廣到StringNotEquals等其他IAM運算子。 十筆中8筆符合錨限制，6筆同時具有正確OU與CN標籤；這6筆中的2筆使用profile-A、4筆使用profile-B。變更僅移除profile-A的issuerCN映射，兩個profile的政策條件完全不變。 原始通過率6/10×100=60%；缺少所需映射後4/10×100=40%。這是固定fixture覆蓋統計，不是AWS實際允許率。
本課採保守規則：只有已確認無狀態變更且可容忍重播的操作能使用早期資料；不合格者延後至握手完成，不等於永久拒絕業務請求。 20種操作中12種通過語意審查；另8種包含計數器、狀態寫入或一次性動作，均從早期資料集合排除。 可准入比例12/20×100=60%；重新確認其中3種其實會寫入後，只餘9種，比例45%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Both profiles use fixed AND conditions: the designated anchor with ArnEquals, plus OU and CN with StringEquals. Missing CN makes this selected equality condition fail. Do not generalize that behavior to StringNotEquals or every IAM operator. Eight of ten rows pass anchor restrictions and six also have correct OU and CN tags. Two of these six use profile-A and four use profile-B. Only profile-A loses its issuerCN mapping; policy conditions remain fixed for both profiles. Baseline fixture pass rate is 6/10×100=60%; the changed mapping gives 4/10×100=40%. These are local test outcomes, not an observed AWS authorization rate.

The local conservative rule admits early data only for operations confirmed to be replay-tolerant and free of state changes. Others wait until handshake completion; delaying early execution does not permanently deny the underlying business operation. Of 20 operation types, 12 pass the semantic review. Eight involve counters, writes or one-time actions and are excluded from early execution. Counts describe operation types, not observed traffic frequency or latency savings. Eligible proportion is 12/20×100=60 percent. Discovering hidden writes in three previously accepted types leaves nine, or 45 percent. The denominator stays fixed because no route was added or removed.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
